title: Discount Impact Calculator
desc: Calculate the true impact of discounts on your profitability — before it hits your bottom line
bogoNote: BOGO: Customer buys 2, pays for 1 — 50% effective discount on pairs
freeShippingNote: Free Shipping: You absorb the shipping cost — same product price, lower net revenue
requiredLift: Required Order Lift to Break Even
alertLiftNotEnoughMsg: You need a {{required}}% order increase instead of {{expected}}% to offset this discount.
alertProfitDownMsg: Total profit drops from {{before}} {{sym}} to {{after}} {{sym}} — a {{pct}}% loss. Increase volume or reduce the discount.
alertProfitUpMsg: Total profit rises from {{before}} {{sym}} to {{after}} {{sym}} — a {{pct}}% gain. This discount is working.
alertMarginTooLowMsg: Post-discount margin ({{margin}}%) is below 10%. Even with higher volume, risk of loss is high.
alertAggressiveDiscountMsg: Discount of {{pct}}% cuts deeply into margin. Ensure volume increase is guaranteed before running this.
noRecommendations: All indicators look good — no recommendations right now
recReduceDiscountDesc: A {{current}}% discount requires {{lift}}% more orders to break even. Dropping to {{suggested}}% would only need {{newLift}}% lift.
recImproveCostsDesc: Your margin before discount is only {{margin}}%. Reducing COGS by {{target}} {{sym}} would give you room to discount safely.
recTestSmallerDesc: Instead of {{current}}%, try {{suggested}}% first. The required lift drops from {{lift}}% to {{newLift}}%, making it much easier to break even.
whatIfHalfDiscountDesc: Reduce discount percentage to lower the break-even bar
whatIfDoubleLiftDesc: More aggressive marketing to drive higher volume
whatIfReduceCostsDesc: Lower product cost to improve margin before discounting
footer: Inspired by Discount Impact Calculator — eCart Solutions
